title: Sparkly watering can
svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id="canGrad" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#5BC8E8"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#2E9CC4"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id="canHighlight" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#8ADDF2"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#5BC8E8"/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- Handle -->
  <path d="M 52 38 Q 60 20 74 24 Q 82 26 80 38 Q 78 46 70 44" 
        fill="none" stroke="#7ED9F0" stroke-width="6" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M 52 38 Q 60 20 74 24 Q 82 26 80 38 Q 78 46 70 44" 
        fill="none" stroke="#A8E8F8" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" opacity="0.5"/>

  <!-- Body -->
  <rect x="22" y="38" width="36" height="34" rx="8" fill="url(#canGrad)"/>
  <rect x="24" y="40" width="14" height="28" rx="6" fill="url(#canHighlight)" opacity="0.5"/>

  <!-- Spout -->
  <path d="M 22 56 L 8 36 L 4 36 L 4 42 L 14 56 Z" fill="#2E9CC4"/>
  <path d="M 22 56 L 8 36 L 14 36 L 22 52 Z" fill="#5BC8E8" opacity="0.6"/>

  <!-- Spout head (rose) -->
  <ellipse cx="5" cy="37" rx="6" ry="4" fill="#F0A030" transform="rotate(-20 5 37)"/>
  <ellipse cx="5" cy="37" rx="4" ry="2.5" fill="#FFD060" transform="rotate(-20 5 37)"/>
  <!-- Water holes -->
  <circle cx="3" cy="36" r="0.8" fill="#2E9CC4"/>
  <circle cx="6" cy="35" r="0.8" fill="#2E9CC4"/>
  <circle cx="4" cy="39" r="0.8" fill="#2E9CC4"/>
  <circle cx="7" cy="38" r="0.8" fill="#2E9CC4"/>

  <!-- Rim / top band -->
  <rect x="22" y="36" width="36" height="6" rx="3" fill="#F0A030"/>
  <rect x="24" y="37" width="32" height="2" rx="1" fill="#FFD060" opacity="0.7"/>

  <!-- Water level line -->
  <rect x="24" y="52" width="32" height="2" rx="1" fill="#A8E8F8" opacity="0.4"/>

  <!-- Sparkles -->
  <!-- Big sparkle top left -->
  <g transform="translate(14 16)">
    <path d="M 0 -6 L 1.5 -1.5 L 6 0 L 1.5 1.5 L 0 6 L -1.5 1.5 L -6 0 L -1.5 -1.5 Z" fill="#FFE84D"/>
  </g>
  <!-- Medium sparkle top right -->
  <g transform="translate(84 14)">
    <path d="M 0 -5 L 1.2 -1.2 L 5 0 L 1.2 1.2 L 0 5 L -1.2 1.2 L -5 0 L -1.2 -1.2 Z" fill="#FFF176"/>
  </g>
  <!-- Small sparkle left -->
  <g transform="translate(10 64)">
    <path d="M 0 -3.5 L 0.9 -0.9 L 3.5 0 L 0.9 0.9 L 0 3.5 L -0.9 0.9 L -3.5 0 L -0.9 -0.9 Z" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  </g>
  <!-- Tiny sparkle right -->
  <g transform="translate(88 52)">
    <path d="M 0 -3 L 0.8 -0.8 L 3 0 L 0.8 0.8 L 0 3 L -0.8 0.8 L -3 0 L -0.8 -0.8 Z" fill="#FFE84D"/>
  </g>
  <!-- Small sparkle bottom -->
  <g transform="translate(46 84)">
    <path d="M 0 -3.5 L 0.9 -0.9 L 3.5 0 L 0.9 0.9 L 0 3.5 L -0.9 0.9 L -3.5 0 L -0.9 -0.9 Z" fill="#FFF176"/>
  </g>
  <!-- Tiny dot sparkles -->
  <circle cx="72" cy="8" r="1.5" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <circle cx="92" cy="34" r="1.5" fill="#FFE84D"/>
  <circle cx="18" cy="82" r="1.5" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <circle cx="82" cy="74" r="1.2" fill="#FFF176"/>
  <circle cx="34" cy="90" r="1.2" fill="#FFE84D"/>

  <!-- Water drop coming from spout -->
  <path d="M 6 44 Q 8 48 6 50 Q 4 48 6 44 Z" fill="#5BC8E8" opacity="0.8"/>
  <path d="M 2 46 Q 3.5 49 2 51 Q 0.5 49 2 46 Z" fill="#7ED9F0" opacity="0.6"/>
</svg>
